name: frexp
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::frexp.Tensor(Tensor self) -> (Tensor mantissa, Tensor exponent). Decomposes each floating input into a fractional mantissa and integral power-of-two exponent. The correctness suite validates both outputs independently, including shape and dtype, across pointwise, zero-size, noncontiguous, signed-zero, infinity, NaN, and invalid integer-input cases. The operation does not mutate or alias self.
